rpcSavings.measurementScope: All gateway traffic during two non-overlapping process-counter intervals, including background automation, audits and controlled benchmark traffic. About 31 seconds of old-gateway drain during replacement are excluded.
rpcSavings.redisIncrementalBaseline: The existing in-memory cache remains enabled. A Redis hit here is an incremental avoided provider request after that memory tier misses.
rpcSavings.counterMeaning: Avoided provider attempts from explicit cache, coalescing and account-batch events. Failed or rejected requests are reported separately, never treated as cache savings.
